posts.text: In a recent interview, Jim Cramer pressed Nvidia’s interim CEO Colette Kress: Although the board has said it will not ask Jensen Huang to return as CEO, given that the president today affirmed his importance to American technology, would the board consider bringing him back in

Jason Wei has left Meta to become chief scientist at Mercor, an AI data company.

On November 17, U.S. time, Mercor CEO Brendan Foody announced that Jason Wei would become chief scientist, responsible for building a research team and overseeing data and evaluation. Jason Wei
posts.quoted: After an amazing year at Meta’s TBD lab, I am very excited to join Mercor as Chief Scientist. Data will shape the next frontier as more companies train AI models than ever before. Mercor is incredible and I look forward to building the future with Brendan, Adarsh, and team!
